hooks.text: Pluto's sky is actively freezing and falling to the ground.
Why didn't Pluto's atmosphere freeze when it moved away?
Pluto's sky was predicted to freeze, but stayed warm.

title: Pluto's Sky Is Freezing Solid Right Now
description: As Pluto moves farther from the Sun in its 248-year orbit, its nitrogen atmosphere is finally collapsing into frost on its surface.

beats.text: Pluto's sky is actively freezing and falling to the ground.
beats.visual: artist concept of atmospheric collapse and ice frost forming on Pluto's surface
queries: Pluto atmosphere freezing surface concept illustration

beats.text: Astronomers expected this collapse right after Pluto passed its closest point.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope global surface map of Pluto from 1996

beats.text: But for decades, its atmospheric pressure unexpectedly refused to drop.
beats.visual: Full globe view of Pluto captured by New Horizons showing Tombaugh Regio
queries: Pluto full globe view New Horizons

beats.text: Nitrogen ice in its heart-shaped basin kept pumping gas into the air.
beats.visual: Nitrogen ice plains and convection cells of Sputnik Planitia

beats.text: Astronomers watched distant stars dim behind Pluto to measure its atmosphere.
beats.visual: Light curve graph showing starlight dimming during a stellar occultation

beats.text: Then measurements revealed a sixteen percent pressure drop starting in 2021.
beats.visual: Haze layers seen in Pluto's atmosphere against dark space during backlighting
queries: Pluto atmospheric haze layers New Horizons

beats.text: As Pluto travels toward its farthest point in 2114, the delay is over.
beats.visual: NASA New Horizons spacecraft in deep space near Pluto illustration
queries: New Horizons flyby Pluto concept art

beats.text: The distant world has entered a centuries-long deep freeze.
beats.visual: artist concept of atmospheric collapse and ice frost forming on Pluto's surface
queries: Pluto atmosphere freezing surface concept illustration

better_than_last: Replaced passive historical background with active observational mystery in beat 2 to prevent early viewer drop-off.
